title: SmartAgri UGM Closes Participation in INAGRITECH 2025 with 2,000 Visitors and Cross-Sector Collaboration Commitment
excerpt: Jakarta – Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada closed its participation in INAGRITECH 2025 with impressive achievements. During three days of the event (July 29–31, 2025), the SmartAgri booth at Hall A3, A303-01 JIEXPO Kemayoran Jakarta recorded over 2,000 visitors, comprising industry practitioners, academics, students, and international partners.
body:
**Jakarta** – Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada closed its participation in _INAGRITECH 2025_ with impressive achievements. During three days of the event (July 29–31, 2025), the SmartAgri booth at Hall A3, A303-01 JIEXPO Kemayoran Jakarta recorded over **2,000 visitors**, comprising industry practitioners, academics, students, and international partners.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/523-1-dsc09258-580x1030.webp)

The third day of the exhibition marked a strong testament to SmartAgri's consistency in communicating research and innovation applicable to the national agricultural sector. Despite entering the final day, visitor enthusiasm remained undiminished. Discussions, technology presentations, and collaboration exploration continued until the closing time.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/523-2-dsc09298-1030x580.webp)

As a token of appreciation, SmartAgri extended its gratitude and recognition to the sponsors who fully supported the success of their participation in this event. Main sponsors include:

-   **PT Cendekia Prima Inovasi**
-   **Quantum Systems Indonesia – PT Quatindo Widjaya Adhirajasa**
-   **PERTETA Jogja**

Support from the sponsors became an important foundation in strengthening the research ecosystem and collaboration among stakeholders, as well as promoting the downstream application of campus-based agricultural technology on a larger scale.

"This achievement is not merely about the number of visitors, but about how far campus research can build genuine connections with the industrial world and society. We are optimistic that the collaborations formed at INAGRITECH 2025 will continue in future agricultural technology initiatives," stated the SmartAgri team in its closing remarks.

SmartAgri UGM's participation in INAGRITECH 2025 reaffirms the university's role as a driver of research-based innovation that is relevant and has real impact on tropical agriculture development, both in national and global contexts.

original.body:
**Jakarta** – Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada menutup partisipasinya dalam ajang _INAGRITECH 2025_ dengan capaian membanggakan. Selama tiga hari pelaksanaan (29–31 Juli 2025), booth SmartAgri di Hall A3, A303-01 JIEXPO Kemayoran Jakarta mencatatkan total lebih dari **2.000 pengunjung**, terdiri dari pelaku industri, akademisi, pelajar, hingga mitra internasional.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/523-1-dsc09258-580x1030.webp)

Hari ketiga pameran menjadi penanda kuatnya konsistensi SmartAgri dalam menyampaikan pesan riset dan inovasi yang aplikatif untuk sektor pertanian nasional. Meskipun memasuki hari terakhir, antusiasme pengunjung tidak surut. Diskusi, presentasi teknologi, dan penjajakan kerja sama masih terus berlangsung hingga waktu penutupan.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/523-2-dsc09298-1030x580.webp)

Sebagai bentuk apresiasi, SmartAgri menyampaikan ucapan terima kasih dan penghargaan kepada para sponsor yang telah mendukung penuh keberhasilan keikutsertaan dalam kegiatan ini. Sponsor utama antara lain:

-   **PT Cendekia Prima Inovasi**
-   **Quantum Systems Indonesia – PT Quatindo Widjaya Adhirajasa**
-   **PERTETA Jogja**

Dukungan dari para sponsor menjadi fondasi penting dalam memperkuat ekosistem riset dan kolaborasi antar pemangku kepentingan, serta mendorong hilirisasi teknologi pertanian berbasis kampus ke skala yang lebih luas.

“Capaian ini bukan hanya soal jumlah pengunjung, tetapi tentang seberapa jauh riset kampus mampu membangun koneksi nyata dengan dunia industri dan masyarakat. Kami optimis kerja sama yang terjalin di INAGRITECH 2025 akan berlanjut pada inisiatif-inisiatif teknologi pertanian ke depan,” terang tim SmartAgri dalam pernyataan penutupnya.

Partisipasi SmartAgri UGM dalam INAGRITECH 2025 mempertegas peran universitas sebagai motor penggerak inovasi berbasis riset yang relevan dan berdampak nyata bagi pengembangan pertanian tropis, baik dalam konteks nasional maupun global.
